npcInfoDialogPort.title: Oleg Rubtsov
npcInfoDialogPort.description:
So, interested in containers?
Well, that's it, our cover was blown — we had to shut this operation down here. Nobody wants to do time.
The bidding is now held in a calmer place.

To find the new location of the container battle, use gps → entertainment → container battle

npcInfoDialogPort.title: Oleg Rubtsov
npcInfoDialogPort.description:
You don't seem like the type to talk nonsense, and there's some trust in you... So let me give you a lift to the new spot.
But don't relax too much, I'm not a taxi driver to keep chauffeuring you around all the time.

Should I take you to Arzamas to the container battle location? Instant travel will work until 01.07.26

npcInfoDialogPort.title: Oleg Rubtsov
npcInfoDialogPort.description:
Alright, our bidding takes place at the 30th minute of every hour — you already know that. But will there be special bidding..?

Not planned for now. But stop by from time to time, maybe something changes.
